'''Deutsche Ausgabe STAR WARS Premiere''' is a Queens Games advertisement for a German-language Star Wars CCG Premiere edition.<ref name="oswm" /><ref name="boardmatt-jp" /> It ran in ''[[Offizielles Star Wars Magazin]]'' issues 8–11 (14 January, 15 April, 15 July and 10 October 1998).<ref name="oswm" />

[[File:OSWM_German_Premiere_ad_BoardMatt_2022.png|thumb|right|260px|Deutsche Ausgabe STAR WARS Premiere, 1998]]
[[File:OSWM_German_Premiere_booster_spread.png|thumb|right|260px|Premiere booster spread, 1998]]

A facing spread shows a Premiere booster with radial how-to-play callouts.<ref name="boardmatt-jp" /> The cancelled Queens Games printing is [[Cancelled German release of SWCCG]].

<blockquote>
'''Deutsche Ausgabe STAR WARS™ Premiere: ab Frühjahr 1998'''

Games Vertrieb für STAR WARS™, STAR TREK: The Next Generation™ Customizable Card Games in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz.

Informationen bei Queens Games unter Telefon 0 22 41 / 49 00 0, Fax 0 22 41 / 49 00 80.
</blockquote>
